title: DARK GOTHIC MAGA: How Tech Billionaires Plan to Destroy America
summary: A political commentary video arguing that tech billionaires such as Thiel, Musk and Andreessen, along with figures like Yarvin, are using the new administration to push their agenda. It connects Yarvin's ideas with Project 2025.
why: HN commenters share it during DOGE and government-cuts threads as a summary of the billionaires' aims, though many only cite it as a reference.

quote.text: This video breaks down who those people are as well as what their motivations are
